recipe.scope: Acquisition variability conditional on fixed successful source-line preparations; no localisation claim or offer change
recipe.uncertainty: Four positive-dose module/bound groups, pooled incident and scored checks each. Two-sided tail budget 0.01/8 per check. Independent fixed-M detection reference; include binomial reference variance. Exact Poisson/binomial tails below 100 expected/observed counts. Assignment/window uncertainty uses outer-seed spread, never binomial hit trials. Report achieved precision without tuning the sample after confirmation.
recipe.twoLineControl: Baseline Cs plus Co-60, both bounds, every outer seed, exact per-line count identities

uncertainty: Incident Poisson mean = rate*T; fixed-M reference binomial variance p(1-p)/M. Scored comparison variance = rate*T*p + (rate*T)^2*p(1-p)/M. Assignment/window intervals use outer-seed spread. Exact identities use zero tolerance; no source fixed-rate Poisson oracle.
